title: Run plugin options change expansion state while scrolling

status.label: Reproduce recycled expansion state
status.detail: Open and unassigned; the report already includes a four-step reproduction and animation. The former ownership claim was unsupported.

next_action.label: Check per-plugin expansion identity
next_action.reason: Determine whether recycled plugin containers transfer expansion state before implementing the scoped state binding.

judgment.rationale: The report is specific enough for maintainer reproduction. Current plugin templates use an ItemsRepeater and do not bind the SettingsExpander expansion state to plugin identity, making recycling a plausible mechanism, not a proven cause.
evidence: PowerToys 0.83.0: expand Calculator, scroll to Windows Walker, expand it, and scroll back; Calculator collapses while Windows Search expands.
The body contains an animation; there are no discussion comments or live assignees.
Current PowerLauncherPage.xaml has an ItemsRepeater plugin template with SettingsExpander but no per-plugin IsExpanded binding.
The reviewed timeline and numeric PR search yielded no linked implementation.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce container reuse, then approve a per-plugin view-state fix only if the hypothesis holds.

fix_assessment.rationale: A repository-side view-state correction is plausible; no concrete existing fix was found in the reviewed links.

proposed_fixes.title: Keep expansion state with the plugin, not the recycled container
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: ItemsRepeater reuses a SettingsExpander whose unbound IsExpanded state belongs to a different plugin, transferring or discarding expansion while scrolling.
plan: Instrument plugin identity and container preparation in src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/SettingsXAML/Views/PowerLauncherPage.xaml to confirm state transfer during the reported scroll sequence.
Add page-lifetime expansion state to PowerLauncherPluginViewModel and bind the plugin SettingsExpander IsExpanded two-way; initialize every newly realized item from its own state.
Add UI regression coverage for multiple expanded plugins leaving and re-entering the viewport; keep plugin enablement and persisted module settings unchanged.
verification: Repeat the report's Calculator/Windows Walker sequence on the current stable build and the candidate; each plugin retains its own expansion state.
Scroll repeatedly, toggle plugin enablement, and navigate away/back; verify intentional page-state reset behavior and no state migration to Windows Search.

confidence.rationale: The unbound virtualized template matches the symptom closely, but no local UI reproduction or container trace was performed.

issue_context.summary: Expanding two distant PowerToys Run plugin sections and scrolling changes which sections are expanded, rather than preserving each plugin's state.
known_information: The four-step sequence and animation are already supplied.
Live issue is open, labeled Issue-Bug/Product-Settings, and unassigned.
inferences: Virtualized container reuse may explain why expansion moves between unrelated plugins; this is not yet runtime-confirmed.
issue_context.analysis: The existing evidence supports a maintainer-side UI test rather than a repeated request for steps or diagnostics. An empty assignee list is not evidence of ownership.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete report, empty discussion, timeline and related-PR search.
Inspected https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/main/src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/SettingsXAML/Views/PowerLauncherPage.xaml: the plugin SettingsExpander lacks an IsExpanded model binding.

prerequisites: Open Run settings with enough plugins to require scrolling.
steps: Expand Calculator and note its plugin identity.
Scroll to Windows Walker and expand it.
Scroll back to Calculator and inspect Calculator, Windows Search and Windows Walker.
Repeat while tracing realized container identities and IsExpanded state.
reproduce.expected_result: Each plugin retains its own expansion state; unrelated plugins never inherit another container's state.

actions.label: Approve per-plugin expansion fix plan
actions.note: Lightweight proposed plan; confirm the recycling hypothesis before implementing. No fork work has been created.
